vif.name: Multicollinearity: VIF
vif.h0: Each term is not explained by the other terms (VIF 1).
vif.advice: Drop or combine the correlated predictors, or turn on a penalty.

epv.h0: At least 10 events for each term of the model.
epv.advice: Few events for the number of terms: fewer terms, or Firth or a penalty help.

cooks_distance.name: Influence: Cook's distance
cooks_distance.h0: No row moves the fit much (Cook's distance under the median of F(p, n − p)).
cooks_distance.advice: Look at the rows named: a mistake in the data, or a case the model does not describe.

leverage.name: Influence: leverage
leverage.h0: No row has an unusual combination of predictors (leverage under 3p/n and under 0.5).
leverage.advice: Look at the rows named: their predictors are far from the others'.

jarque_bera.name: Normality of residuals: Jarque–Bera
jarque_bera.h0: The residuals' skewness and kurtosis are a normal distribution's.
jarque_bera.advice: The intervals rely on normal errors: with few rows read them with care, or transform the outcome.

vif.name: Multicollinearità: VIF

cooks_distance.name: Influenza: distanza di Cook
cooks_distance.h0: Nessuna riga sposta di molto la stima (distanza di Cook sotto la mediana di F(p, n − p)).

leverage.name: Influenza: leva
leverage.h0: Nessuna riga ha una combinazione insolita di predittori (leva sotto 3p/n e sotto 0,5).
leverage.advice: Guardate le righe indicate: i loro predittori sono lontani da quelli delle altre.

jarque_bera.name: Normalità dei residui: Jarque–Bera
jarque_bera.h0: Asimmetria e curtosi dei residui sono quelle di una normale.

cooks_distance.name: Einfluss: Cook-Distanz
cooks_distance.h0: Keine Zeile verschiebt die Schätzung stark (Cook-Distanz unter dem Median von F(p, n − p)).
cooks_distance.advice: Prüfen Sie die genannten Zeilen: ein Fehler in den Daten oder ein Fall, den das Modell nicht beschreibt.

leverage.name: Einfluss: Hebelwert

leverage.advice: Prüfen Sie die genannten Zeilen: Ihre Prädiktoren liegen weit von denen der anderen.

jarque_bera.name: Normalverteilung der Residuen: Jarque–Bera
jarque_bera.h0: Schiefe und Wölbung der Residuen sind die einer Normalverteilung.
jarque_bera.advice: Die Intervalle setzen normalverteilte Fehler voraus: bei wenigen Zeilen mit Vorsicht lesen, oder die Zielgröße transformieren.

cooks_distance.name: Influence : distance de Cook
cooks_distance.h0: Aucune ligne ne déplace beaucoup l'ajustement (distance de Cook sous la médiane de F(p, n − p)).

jarque_bera.name: Normalité des résidus : Jarque–Bera
